newsitem.title: USA: WHX raises cash offer for Dynamics Corp.
newsitem.headline: WHX raises cash offer for Dynamics Corp.

text.p: WHX Corp. said Tuesday its SB Acquisition Corp. subsidiary extended its tender offer for Dynamics Corp. of America until June 13, and increased the cash offer to about $212 million from $204 million.
Under terms of the offer, WHX is offering $56 per share for Dynamics Corp., up from $55.
Dynamics on May 12 agreed to be acquired by CTS Corp. for $55 per share in cash and stock.
WHX said in a news release that the only impediment to its latest proposal was Dynamics' shareholder rights plan, which WHX urged Dynamics to rescind.
WHX said its offer was a better deal for Dynamics shareholders than the CTS offer to acquire 50 percent of the company immediately for cash, and the balance several months later for stock.

WHX initially launched a $40-a-share offer for Dynamics Corp. late in March and then raised its bid to $45 in April. In rejecting WHX's offer, Dynamics Corp. said it was pursuing alternative transactions.
As of the close of business on Friday, May 23, WHX said that there were approximately 420,000 shares of Dynamics Corp. stock tendered to the depositary.
Dynamics Corp. makes consumer electrical housewares and industrial equipment. Its stock was up 87.5 cents to $57.625 in consolidated late afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
WHX, a steelmaker, was unchanged at $6.375.
